weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
Foes with Range = 1 cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills). Foes with Range = 2 cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of unit (does not affect foes with Pass skills).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (for unit, X = 15; for allies, X = 5), neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit or ally, grants Special cooldown count-Y to unit or ally and inflicts Special cooldown+Y on foe before unit's or ally's first attack during combat (if unit or ally has weapon-triangle advantage, Y = 2; otherwise, Y = 1; effects on foe's Special cooldown count trigger only if foe's attack can trigger foe's Special; cannot exceed the foe's maximum Special cooldown).
Unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Unit can use the following【Style】:
――――――― Light Brand Style ―――――――
Unit can attack foes 2 spaces away (unit cannot attack adjacent foes).
Decreases Spd difference necessary for unit to make a follow-up attack by 10 and calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of foe that has triggered the Bulwark effect (does not apply if unit has a Pass skill). Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe is armored with Range = 1, foe can counterattack regardless of unit's range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe.
After-combat movement effects do not occur. Skill effect's Range is treated as 1. This Style can be used only once per turn.
――――――――――――――――――――――――
【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

special.d:
When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's Spd.
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants 【Truly Incited】and【Null Follow-Up】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by 40% (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and unit attacks twice during combat.
If foe initiates combat, triggers the following effects when determining weapon triangle: if foe is counted as red, unit is counted as blue; if foe is counted as green, unit is counted as red; if foe is counted as colorless, grants weapon-triangle advantage to unit and inflicts weapon-triangle disadvantage on foe (if number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≤ 3, this effect triggers in up to 2 combat instances per turn; otherwise, this effect triggers any number of times. Does not affect skill effects that trigger based on attribute, such as "if in combat against a red foe").
If foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that boost values along with weapon-triangle advantage or reduce values along with weapon-triangle disadvantage (Triangle Adept) on unit and foe.
【Truly Incited】
Grants bonus to Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat × 2 (max 8).
【Null Follow-Up】
If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.

a.d: If foe initiates combat or if unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def+2 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit has weapon-triangle advantage, X = 3; if unit has weapon-triangle disadvantage, X = 1; if neither, X = 2).

If foe initiates combat or if unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def+4 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit has weapon-triangle advantage, X = 6; if unit has weapon-triangle disadvantage, X = 2; if neither, X = 4).

If foe initiates combat or if unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def+7 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit has weapon-triangle advantage, X = 10; if unit has weapon-triangle disadvantage, X = 4; if neither, X = 7).

If foe initiates combat or if unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def+10 to unit, neutralizes penalties on unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by X (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit has weapon-triangle advantage, X = 15; if unit has weapon-triangle disadvantage, X = 5; if neither, X = 10), and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack).

b.d: If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 2 (max 20%). Neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit.

If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 3 (max 30%). Neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit.

If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 4 (max 40%). Neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit.

If a skill compares unit's Spd to a foe's or ally's Spd, treats unit's Spd as if granted +7.
Reduces damage from area-of-effect Specials by 80% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials).
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def-4 on foe, neutralizes foe's bonuses, deals damage = 20% of unit's Spd (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 20% of unit's Spd (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and neutralizes effects that prevent unit's counterattacks during combat.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, if unit's HP = 100%, unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, unit can move 1 extra space. (That turn only. Does not stack.)

Enables【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】.
At start of turn, unit can move 1 extra space (that turn only; does not stack).
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X to unit (X = 2 × number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 6), unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit before the above, +1. (Max ４.)
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)
